notes.title: Over The Top: WWI September Playtest!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206562/e44b578dd42a3467465f4176b372f8f78fc34149.png"][/img]We are excited to announce that the next public alpha Playtest for Over The Top: WWI will begin on the 25th of September 2025!  [/p][previewyoutube="n4kNmJ_CrlM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]As previously announced we are looking to host a couple of public Playtests prior to release of Over The Top: WWI, so that we can find bugs, get feedback and tweak gameplay well ahead of the official release.  [/p][p][i]Please keep in mind that the game is still in alpha and a number of features have not yet been implemented. There will be bugs and performance issues as well unfinished gameplay.  [/i]

If you are interested in participating in the Playtest, you can register for it from our Steam Store Page. Once registered, you will be notified once the Playtest starts.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778610/Over_The_Top_WWI/"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you! We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield very soon! 
[i]/Flying Squirrel Entertainment[/i]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206562/114135d0b5a3c41a5a46ed1f4b6e4eb40decfefe.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Over The Top: WWI August Playtest!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206562/e44b578dd42a3467465f4176b372f8f78fc34149.png"][/img]We are excited to announce that the next public alpha Playtest for Over The Top: WWI will begin on the 7th of August 2025!  [/p][p][/p][p]This playtest will focus on various improvements and fixes we have done over the past couple of weeks, including UI, aiming, smoothness and general polish and quality of life. [/p][p][/p][p]As previously announced we are looking to host a couple of public Playtests prior to release of Over The Top: WWI, so that we can find bugs, get feedback and tweak gameplay well ahead of the official release.  [/p][p][i]Please keep in mind that the game is still in alpha and a number of features have not yet been implemented. There will be bugs and performance issues as well unfinished gameplay.  [/i]

If you are interested in participating in the Playtest, you can register for it from our Steam Store Page. Once registered, you will be notified once the Playtest starts.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778610/Over_The_Top_WWI/"][/dynamiclink]
Thank you! We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield very soon! 
[i]/Flying Squirrel Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: July Playtest Small Patch
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]First of all, thank you for helping us test the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable, and it is already helping us make improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]We have just pushed [i]a small patch[/i] that addresses some issues we could easily address with a client side patch. If you haven't received the update yet, try restarting Steam to download.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed sniper scopes being off-center when aiming in first-person.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing VOIP to break for everyone on the server.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed VOIP defaulting to 2D instead of proximity-based audio.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced screenshake from grenade explosions and other effects. The game should now feel much more playable. notes.title: December Playtest - Retrospective
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206562/e44b578dd42a3467465f4176b372f8f78fc34149.png[/img]

Hey guys!
We would like to take a moment to reflect on the December playtest for Over The Top: WWI! Thanks to all of you, it was a huge success and an experience we won't soon forget. 

In this post, we'll share what we learned, some exciting highlights, and what’s next for the game. Additionally, we would like to invite you to support Over The Top: WWI by voting for it in [url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2024-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote83950]IndieDB’s Indie Game of the Year[/url] competition. 

[h2]Numbers[/h2]
First, let’s talk about the numbers! Over 17,000 unique players joined the battlefield during the playtest, smashing our record for concurrent users. The response was so overwhelming that we had to wake up in the middle of the night to spin up additional servers to keep up with demand. Thank you so much; you guys are amazing!

[h2]Performance[/h2]
The playtest was also a valuable learning experience, and while we're proud of the strides we’ve made, there’s still work to do. Performance was one of the most significant challenges we noticed. With the game’s dynamic and chaotic nature, maintaining smooth FPS for all players is tricky. We’re focused on tackling these issues head-on to enhance the game’s performance for all players. 

[h2]Spawn System and Balance
[/h2]Another area that came to light was the Officer Spawn system. Right now, it’s a little to easy to spawn on officers. Teams could easily overwhelm opponents by constantly respawning at officers, providing a never ending flow of players. We're planning an overhaul for the next playtest to strike a better balance.

Map Balance was another major issue this playtest. For example, on Alpenflugplatz, we noticed players sneaking behind enemy defenses to camp capture points that weren’t even active yet. We are planning adjustments to keep the battles intense but fair.

And let’s talk about those flamethrowers! They’re undeniably powerful; we tried to adress this during the playtest by limiting the number of specialists per server; with limited success. In certain maps, they tipped the scales too much in favor of attackers. We’ve got some ideas to address this and will be testing adjustments next playtest.

[h2]Campaign Mode[/h2]
On a more positive note, our new Campaign mode is shaping up nicely! Players enjoyed it, but  the UI could do a better job explaining what’s happening during critical moments. We’ll also be fixing a bug that restricted voting options to just one choice in some cases. Expect a more polished experience in the next playtest. 

Here are some screenshots showcasing the aftermath of the 3rd Battle at Nimy Bridge and Collineaux Hills. Remember, these two maps start out with NO destruction... The level of destruction is truly remarkable and highlights the intensity of the combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/f5625be3de31b1c7baec852ece03ee39a245a808.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/39da35cef2020c7535c05e198394013b605cea00.jpg[/img]

[h2]Armored Class[/h2]
The new Armored class showed promising results during the playtest. It functioned as intended, introducing a new tactical layer to gameplay. Observing how players utilized this class gave us valuable insights, and we’re eager to see how it evolves with further refinements in future updates.

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Of course, none of this would have been possible without YOU. Thank you for your participation, feedback, and enthusiasm. Seeing you engage with the game at such a massive scale is what keeps us pushing forward.

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2024-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote83950][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/fa0226b152c5898d833fdbfbd900ee99045042c0.png[/img]
[/url]

Lastly, we have one small favor to ask. Over The Top: WWI is competing in IndieDB’s[url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2024-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote83950] Indie Game of the Year awards[/url], and your [url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2024-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote83950]vote [/url]could make all the difference! If you’ve enjoyed the game or are excited about where it’s headed, please take a moment to [url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2024-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote83950]vote for us[/url]. It’s a great way to support our team and help spread the word about the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778610/Over_The_Top_WWI/

Thank you again for being part of this incredible journey. We’ll see you in the trenches (or on IndieDB)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206562/e44b578dd42a3467465f4176b372f8f78fc34149.png[/img]

Hey guys! 
We are excited to announce that the public December Playtest for Over The Top: WWI is now live and will last from the 4th till 9th December 2024!

[previewyoutube=GGpzPFUjtS4;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been a while since our last playtest, and we're excited to share all the new additions and improvements we've made. With a change-log spanning hundreds of entries, we’ll spare you the full list here and instead highlight the most noticeable and impactful updates to Over The Top: WWI!

Here are the key changes of this playtest:

[h3][b]Campaign Gamemode[/b][/h3]
The main focus of this playtest is to put our newly implemented Campaign Gamemode to the test. Currently available exclusively in multiplayer, this mode will eventually also make its way to the single-player.

[list]
[*] [b]Fight for Territory:[/b] In Campaign Mode, both teams battle to capture and hold a series of territories. The team with the most territories at the end of the campaign will win the campaign.
[*] [b]Dynamic Map System:[/b] Each territory is represented by a unique playable map. Once a map has been fought over, it can’t be selected again for one round - but it can return to the rotation later.
[*] [b]Persistent Destruction:[/b] Campaign Mode isn’t just about capturing territory - it’s about changing it forever. Craters, player-dug trenches, destroyed trees, and even demolished buildings persist across battles. As the campaign progresses, maps transform from lush landscapes into the desolate hellscapes that define WWI.
[*] [b]Time and Atmosphere:[/b] Maps will now feature random times of day, so prepare for the challenges of nighttime combat or the eerie glow of dawn. In the future, we also plan to add dynamic seasons and weather - imagine waging war in snow-covered trenches or icy wastelands.
[*] [b]Battle Stats:[/b] After each battle, detailed statistics will be displayed, including the number of shells fired, vehicles destroyed, and more. Relive the intensity of each fight with these in-depth post-match summaries.
[*] [b]We Need Your Feedback:[/b] The Campaign Mode UI is still a work in progress, and we want to hear from you! Your input will help us refine the experience, so please let us know what’s working well and especially what needs improvement. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/f2c2dfd4f2eda0735624cb263434225e2a7e44a6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/223c1116d57255a3d47e86e017dac096d7290c8a.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Class System Rework[/b][/h3]
Following feedback from the previous playtest, we observed that the Mechanic class was underutilized and lacked effectiveness. To address this, we’ve replaced it with the new [i]Armoured Class[/i].

This class is built for resilience, featuring steel-plated armor, heavy helmets, and face masks. While the Armoured Class sacrifices speed - it is unable to sprint - it excels in durability: it takes significantly lower damage to the upper body and head.

Additionally, the wrench from the Mechanic class has been reassigned to the Rifleman class, where it can now be unlocked, ensuring it remains accessible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/5451f1bc79dbea6c1f4d41e31244a26327290ba2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/fcc22c8a4d5975e840c3c9a21d16491546df8cb9.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]New Uniforms[/b][/h3]
The British faction has been outfitted with a number of new Scottish Uniforms. In addition to the rifleman class, both the British Stormtrooper and Engineer now have access to Scottish uniforms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/b894149321eb459e80b541310d18041471295c30.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/6e3a1cc6daca4be34ea387436a9567c371857475.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]New Map[/b][/h3]
We've introduced a new map to the game: [i]Alpenflugplatz[/i]. This map boasts rugged, mountainous terrain, complete with winding tunnels and narrow paths cutting through the rocky landscape. At its heart lies a German airfield, surrounded by open space - perfect for players to dig their own trenches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/358010eef7877b391c3d71fc1e76119592af31c1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/d566ddfc59a038139fb2293b9facc0970a2a5353.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/9dc861f39ba556275289a415147616591ca20bf6.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Reworked Vehicle Physics[/b][/h3]
All wheeled vehicles have been upgraded with an entirely new physics system! Say goodbye to the days of awkwardly floating vehicles and overly bouncy, unrealistic suspensions. The new system delivers smoother, more realistic movement, enhancing both the visuals and the feel of vehicle handling on the battlefield.

[h3][b]Motorbikes![/b][/h3]
In addition to the new vehicle physics we have also added motorbikes with sidecars... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/3715e80b47120ab12016143e1145d07883908e77.jpg[/img][h3][b]Reworked Perks and Troop Menu[/b][/h3]
We’ve reworked all perks to make them more unique and impactful. These changes aim to enhance gameplay variety and strategy, but your feedback is invaluable—let us know what you think!

Additionally, the troop menu has been revamped for clarity and convenience. Descriptions are now more concise, and weapon stats are displayed directly within the menu, eliminating the need to navigate into each weapon's customization menu.

[h3][b]Other changes[/b][/h3]
There are hundreds of smaller and larger changes and additions we’ve made, so we highly recommend jumping in and checking out the game for yourself. Your feedback is crucial to us, so please share your thoughts on our Discord or the Steam Forums. The more detailed and frequent the feedback, the better we can refine the game.

Hey guys! 
We are excited to announce that the fourth public Alpha Playtest for Over The Top: WWI is now live and will last from the 6th till 9th September 2024!

[previewyoutube=9IQ6f79Oalo;full][/previewyoutube]
Since the last playtest, we've primarily focused on improving FPS performance. This has been a challenging task, but we hope the optimizations we've made have significantly enhanced the game’s overall performance. Now, we need to test these changes to ensure we're on the right track, enabling us to continue refining the experience.

For this playtest, our main focus will be on tracking player FPS. We've integrated automatic telemetry to monitor FPS during gameplay, allowing us to gather valuable data. After the playtest, we’ll analyze this information to determine the best direction for further development.

To ensure accurate comparisons, we won't be adding any new maps for this playtest. Introducing new environments could skew the performance data, making it less useful. We understand this may be disappointing, but it’s a necessary step in the game's development process, and there’s no way to bypass it.

Despite the focus on performance tracking, we’re still introducing some new and updated content. You'll find balance adjustments, numerous bug fixes, and new uniform unlocks to explore. Even if you participated in the previous test, we encourage you to check out the latest changes and provide your feedback.

Here are some of the key changes in this playtest:

[h3][b]FPS Improvements[/b][/h3]
The primary focus of this playtest is to test our performance improvements. We have implemented numerous improvements across various systems in the game to deliver a smoother and more responsive experience.

[h3][b]Upscaler[/b][/h3]
If you're GPU limited, you may want to try out the FSR 3.1 or XeSS upscaling techniques we've integrated, with XeSS being the preferred option due to its superior quality. You can enable upscaling in the [i]Video[/i] options. This may provide significant performance boosts at the expense of some graphical fidelity. 

Please note that both the upscaler and the new anti-aliasing (AA) are still experimental, which might result in unwanted behavior and ghosting artifacts. XeSS tends to produce fewer artifacts, which is why it is the recommended upscaler in Over The Top: WWI.

[h3][b]New AA techniques[/b][/h3]
We have enhanced the Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA) technique, resulting in noticeably fewer jagged edges. Additionally, you can now enable FSRAA and XeSSAA, which deliver great AA results - especially XeSSAA - while incurring minimal performance costs. We encourage you to try them out!

[h3][b]New Uniforms[/b][/h3]
The British faction has been outfitted with a variety of new uniforms, including authentic officers' garb, backpacks, and haversacks. Additionally, the Black Watch Highlander uniform is now available for unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/2a8d28a6c13290c9b4f30e0b26e0a459d4826d3e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Randomly Generated Maps[/b][/h3]
We have implemented the first version of randomly generated maps into the game. We might randomly switch to them every now and then, but they will not be in the map rotation for now. Still very experimental. It will be interesting to see how they play. 

[h3][b]Weapon Accuracy[/b][/h3]
We have introduced several new systems that impact gunplay, particularly for automatic and semi-automatic rifles and pistols.

[i]Movement Accuracy:[/i] Firing weapons while moving will now significantly increase sway and reduce accuracy. This has been fine-tuned on a per-weapon basis, meaning some weapons handle movement better than others. For example, carbines experience only a minor accuracy penalty, whereas Light Machine Guns suffer a more substantial reduction in accuracy.

[i]Burst Firing:[/i] Weapons should now be fired in short bursts. Continuously firing full-auto weapons will cause their accuracy to deteriorate over time, while firing in short bursts will prevent this issue.

The primary focus of this playtest is to test our performance improvements. We have implemented numerous improvements across various systems in the game to deliver a smoother and more responsive experience.

[h3][b]Upscaler[/b][/h3]
If you're GPU limited, you may want to try out the FSR 3.1 or XeSS upscaling techniques we've integrated, with XeSS being the preferred option due to its superior quality. You can enable upscaling in the [i]Video[/i] options. This may provide significant performance boosts at the expense of some graphical fidelity. 

Please note that both the upscaler and the new anti-aliasing (AA) are still experimental, which might result in unwanted behavior and ghosting artifacts. XeSS tends to produce fewer artifacts, which is why it is the recommended upscaler in Over The Top: WWI.

[h3][b]New AA techniques[/b][/h3]
We have enhanced the Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA) technique, resulting in noticeably fewer jagged edges. Additionally, you can now enable FSRAA and XeSSAA, which deliver great AA results - especially XeSSAA - while incurring minimal performance costs. We encourage you to try them out!

[h3][b]New Uniforms[/b][/h3]
The British faction has been outfitted with a variety of new uniforms, including authentic officers' garb, backpacks, and haversacks. Additionally, the Black Watch Highlander uniform is now available for unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/2a8d28a6c13290c9b4f30e0b26e0a459d4826d3e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Randomly Generated Maps[/b][/h3]
We have implemented the first version of randomly generated maps into the game. We might randomly switch to them every now and then, but they will not be in the map rotation for now. Still very experimental. It will be interesting to see how they play. 

[h3][b]Weapon Accuracy[/b][/h3]
We have introduced several new systems that impact gunplay, particularly for automatic and semi-automatic rifles and pistols.

[i]Movement Accuracy:[/i] Firing weapons while moving will now significantly increase sway and reduce accuracy. This has been fine-tuned on a per-weapon basis, meaning some weapons handle movement better than others. For example, carbines experience only a minor accuracy penalty, whereas Light Machine Guns suffer a more substantial reduction in accuracy.

[i]Burst Firing:[/i] Weapons should now be fired in short bursts. Continuously firing full-auto weapons will cause their accuracy to deteriorate over time, while firing in short bursts will prevent this issue.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]The second alpha Playtest for Over The Top: WWI will start on Friday the 6th of September and will end on the 9th of September.[/b]

[i]Please keep in mind that the game is still in alpha and a number of features have not yet been implemented. There will be bugs and performance issues as well unfinished gameplay. 
[/i]

If you are interested in participating in the Playtest, you can register for it from our Steam Store Page. Once registered, you will be notified once the Playtest starts.

[*]Tank main guns now do 2 times as much damage.

[*]Fixed that you could not put down machine guns and engineer constructibles on floors in buildings or destroyed ruin walls.

[*]Decreased melee switching time.
[*]Adjusted pickaxe position on German backpacks and size on British Soldiers when holstered.
[*]Increased health of various engineer constructibles.
[*]Adjusted build point costs of various engineer constructibles. 
[*]Fixed incorrect bleed out icon over downed players.
[*]Fixed that you could not place props ontop of train-tracks. 
[*]British Engineers now have access to pioneer shovels. 
[*]Increased the amount of predicted frames on rifle grenades, making the prediction ray more accurate.
[*]Reduced dig radius check near objects, making it easier to dig near objects.
[*]Fixed Korean and Japanese translations not appearing correctly.
[*]Changed camera offset when dying inside a vehicle.
[*]Fixed error in death screen Ui and made it show up when you killed yourself.
[*]Fixed an ammo bug when picking up weapons.
[*]Can no longer win by score in linear gamemode unless the time runs out.
[*]You can no longer take fall damage when swimming.
[*]You can no longer put gas mask on when downed.
[*]Camera now moves down when reviving people.
[*]Fixed a bug with player level in scoreboard showing incorrectly.
[/list]

[u][b]Performance:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Decreased memory usage slightly for better performance. 
[*]Decreased number of grass elements spawned by x8 times while keeping the same density which should yield performance improvements on low VRAM machines. 
[*]Updated watershaders with improved rendering tech.
[/list]

We would greatly appreciate your support in spreading the word about Over The Top: WWI's presence at Steam Next Fest. 

Please share this news with your gaming communities and Discord Servers. Gather your friends, join the servers, and play a few rounds. 

The more players, the more fun!

notes.title: Second alpha Playtest is now LIVE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206562/e44b578dd42a3467465f4176b372f8f78fc34149.png[/img]

The Second alpha [b]Playtest for Over The Top: WWI is now live![/b] The Playtest will last from the Saturday the 25th May at 16:00 Berlin (24:00 Sydney, 10:00 New York) and will end on the 26th May at 06:00 Berlin.

[b]You can participate play the game now and participate in the test by joining it from our Steam Store Page here:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778610/Over_The_Top_WWI/

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
Here are the most important changes between the last Playtest from the 14th of April and this Playtest.

[h3]4 New Vehicles[/h3]
We added 4 new vehicles to the game. Each Faction now has access to an Armored Car and a Transport Vehicle. 

[b]Armored Cars[/b]
Armored Cars are even faster than light tanks and are equipped with a heavy machine gun turret. However they are only lightly armored and can be destroyed quickly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/1c280eaf3a49e1db9c597039e6eaa74c290cfe72.jpg[/img]

[b]Transport Vehicles[/b]
Transport vehicles are capable of transporting up to 12 troops plus one driver. They are very fast but lack any kind of armor, so be on the look out for enemy gun emplacements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/e1cccee9b3d624dcbb301885db07928781a7f0af.jpg[/img]

[b]First Person Camera[/b]
One of the most requested feature was the addition of first person to the game. You can now enter first person by pressing V.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/975edaacbced74df19bd0c8895282acf87c8d832.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Uniforms[/h3]
The German Officer and the German Heavy Gunner have received entirely new uniforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/e4b041e492847cf1b04932ff56725dc3ef27a228.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Maps[/h3]
This playtest will feature two new maps. Both maps are set in the early stages of the war and feature only a few trenches, so you better get your shovels ready! 

[b]Weris Village[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/6be258c94ff6d05932b8045ba91f9d6fdd9df5c7.jpg[/img]

[b]Beaucourt Railway[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/77085a5c13f4beac7a09f5e8cbd35df6d76d44ce.jpg[/img]

[h3]Vehicle User Interface[/h3]
We have implemented a new Vehicle User Interface. Located to the bottom left next to the health bar, you will now be able to tell which direction your gun is facing and which seat corresponds to which gun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/9a8df607f327dabb782eae070a3ee62b70010f23.gif[/img]

[h3]Player on Player collision[/h3]
To prevent players from blocking entryways and getting stuck in tight places such as tunnels, staircases or trenches, players within the same team will no longer collide with each other. Players from opposite teams however will still collide. Players that are bleeding out will also no longer prevent players from moving over them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889679/9f83aa340899b38e2266e60b21313f46200bbf2a.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
We added a ton of other smaller changes and additions. Here are the most important of them:

[b]Visible Map Borders[/b]
We made map borders slowly blend in the closer you get to them, notifying you of their existence. 

[b]Reloading Changes[/b]
Clicking any Mouse-Button while not reloaded will now automatically reload your rifle, preventing you from aiming your rifle if unloaded. 

[b]Grenade Perk and Explosions[/b]
The Grenade Perk now also improves the damage output of any grenades you throw and you can throw them slightly further. Explosions will now also no longer damage you through the ground.

[b]Spawn Protection Zones[/b]
We implemented a Spawn Protection Zone system that prevents enemy players from entering your spawn area and spawn killing players. It will notify players entering a zone by the screen turning grey.

[b]Machine Gun Fire Rate[/b]
We uncoupled the MG fire-rate from your ping, meaning that no matter how high or low your ping, machine guns will now always fire the same speed.

[b]Turn off HUD[/b]
Pressing H will now turn off/on your user interface.

Thank you! We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield very soon! 
[i]/Flying Squirrel Entertainment[/i]

As the second public alpha Playtest for Over The Top: WWI will start tomorrow and last from the 25th till 26th May 2024, we thought that it might be useful to answer some of your most asked questions. 

So lets get right to it!

[b]Q:[/b] [b]When will the playtest be?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]The first alpha Playtest for Over The Top: WWI will start on Saturday the 25th May at 16:00 Berlin (24:00 Sydney, 10:00 New York) and will end on the 26th May at 06:00 Berlin.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]How do I participate?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]If you are interested in participating in the Playtest, you can register for it from our Steam Store Page. Once registered, you will be notified once the Playtest starts.
[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778610/Over_The_Top_WWI/

[b]Q:[/b] [b]Will there be Singleplayer?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]No. This playtest will not feature any Singleplayer. Later playtests will however feature singleplayer. We currently want to test multiplayer.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Will there be more Playtests prior to release?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]Yes, we plan on hosting several playtest before release of Over The Top: WWI.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]What will be in the Playtest?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]The Playtest will feature Multiplayer with 6 maps. You will be able to test all core features of the game, including Tanks and Machine Guns. However, some items such as uniforms and some features are currently not yet implemented. 
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Compare to the previous playtest, what will be new?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]This playtest will feature 2 new maps, new vehicles and plenty of other smaller changes and additions. We will post a more in depth changelog tomorrow.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]How many Servers will there be?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]We will be hosting a server in Europe and North America. The AUS community will also be hosting a server in Australia. 
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Will there be bots?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]Yes, the Servers will have a few bots enabled. Each player joining the Server will also replace a bot. Once enough players have joined the server, there will be no bots. 
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]What is the purpose of the Playtest?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]The purpose of this test is to find bugs and get feedback on the current gameplay way ahead of the release of Over The Top: WWI. We will also spend special attention on weapon balance and FPS performance.

[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Will there be bugs and performance issues?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]Yes! There will be bugs and there likely will be performance issues. That is why we are testing. We need to find as many bugs and issues as possible, so that we can fix them.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Where can I report bugs or provide feedback?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]You can do so on our Discord. 
[/i]

[b]A:[/b] [i]If you are interested in participating in the Playtest, you can register for it from our Steam Store Page. Once registered, you will be notified once the Playtest starts.
[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778610/Over_The_Top_WWI/

[b]Q:[/b] [b]Will there be Singleplayer?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]No. This playtest will not feature any Singleplayer. Later playtests will however feature singleplayer. We currently want to test multiplayer.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Will there be more Playtests prior to release?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]Yes, we plan on hosting several playtest before release of Over The Top: WWI.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]What will be in the Playtest?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]The Playtest will feature Multiplayer with 4 maps. You will be able to test all core features of the game, including Tanks and Machine Guns. However, some items such as uniforms and some features are currently not yet implemented.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]How many Servers will there be?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]We will be hosting an EU and a NA Server. 
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Will there be bots?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]Yes, the Servers will have a few bots enabled. Each player joining the Server will also replace a bot. Once enough players have joined the server, there will be no bots. 
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]What is the purpose of the Playtest?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]The purpose of this test is to find bugs and get feedback on the current gameplay way ahead of the release of Over The Top: WWI. We will also spend special attention on weapon balance and FPS performance.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Will I keep my unlocks after the Playtest?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]No. All Unlocks will be reset. However, we have multiplied the unlock rate for this playtest, so you will earn them quicker. We might also re-order, remove and add unlocks after the playtest, so keeping them is going to be impossible.  
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Will there be bugs and performance issues?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]Yes! There will be bugs and there likely will be performance issues. That is why we are testing. We need to find as many bugs and issues as possible, so that we can fix them.
[/i]
[b]Q:[/b] [b]Where can I report bugs or provide feedback?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]You can do so on our Discord. 
[/i]

Thank you! We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield very soon!
